2115235021087023411.en_summary: OpenAI reportedly plans to buy $GOOGL TPUs while $ORCL prepares to rent them out which would expand Google's custom chips beyond its own cloud. Great for $AVGO as AI labs increasingly add TPUs alongside $NVDA GPUs to secure more compute rather than rely on a single supplier.
2115235021087023411.zh_summary: 據報 OpenAI 計劃購買 $GOOGL TPU，而 $ORCL 準備出租，這將把 Google 客製晶片擴展至自家雲端之外。對 $AVGO 有利，因為 AI 實驗室越來越多地在 $NVDA GPU 之外加入 TPU 以確保更多算力，而非依賴單一供應商。

ticker_notes.AVGO: AI 實驗室增加 TPU 需求

2115233651734782426.en_summary: $SKHY SK hynix Q3 revenue $78.8B vs est $74B, operating profit $62.8B vs $58B. First quarter over ₩100T, ~80% margins. Guiding ~₩100T ($75B) shareholder returns FY26. ₩20,000 Q3 dividend half one-off. LTAs with 14 major customers cover 50%+ of 2027 and 2028 capacity. Demand to beat supply through 2030. Hard not to like. Also $MU $SNDK.
2115233651734782426.zh_summary: $SKHY SK hynix 第三季營收 788 億美元對比預期 740 億，營業利潤 628 億對比 580 億。首季超過 100 兆韓元，約 80% 利潤率。指引 2026 財年約 100 兆韓元（750 億美元）股東回報。第三季股息 2 萬韓元，一半為一次性。與 14 家主要客戶的長期協議覆蓋 2027 和 2028 年 50% 以上產能。需求預計到 2030 年超過供應。難以不喜歡。亦提及 $MU $SNDK。

ticker_notes.MU: SK Hynix 強勁業績及長期需求利好記憶體
